aarti.tek: This is the āratī of Śrī Vṛṣabhānu's daughter,
the lovely embodiment of Mohana's love.
aarti.pad1: Destroyer of worldly existence with its threefold afflictions,
who makes pure discernment and dispassion bloom,
who lights up pure love for the Lord's feet —
this is the āratī of the loveliest image of beauty itself.
aarti.pad2: Enchantress of Mohana, who enchants the minds of sages;
of sweet, charming and graceful form;
who draws the nectar-juice of unbroken love —
this is the āratī of her who is ever most dear to her friend Lalitā.
aarti.pad3: Ever to be served by saints and sages;
the mine of countless hosts of divine virtues;
who draws Kṛṣṇa's body and mind —
this is the āratī of the most priceless wealth of equanimity.
aarti.pad4: who sports in the forest of Vṛndā made of consciousness;
mother of the world, remover of the world's sorrow —
this is the āratī of the first and beginningless power of all-pervading lordship.
